messages:
alex li: Hey folks — opened a small PR that touches the batcher + KV eviction path + a tiny scheduling tweak in the attention kernel. Can someone PTAL when you have a minute? Link: https://git.company/repo/pulls/1234

Primary risk: when sequence_len spikes we can evict a cached prefix during a continuous-batch prefetch and that can cause a KV lookup miss -> unexpected memory growth on long requests. I added a fallback to force single-request mode for the affected code path and a smoke test that simulates long sequences. Plan is to merge in tonight's low-traffic window (00:30 UTC) if no blockers. cc @maria @david @lee

maria gonzalez: Quick skim — overall looks good. One nit: the fallback lives in runtime/batcher.rs; any reason not to put the higher-level decision in runtime/kv_cache.rs so we keep eviction semantics colocated?

alex li: Good point. I debated that. Reason I put it in batcher: the decision needs immediate access to the current batch shape and the in-flight prefetch token; moving it to kv_cache would require plumbing a new signal. I can either add a small accessor or move the logic if folks prefer separation. Open to suggestions.

david cho: I can take a look in ~30m. If you can drop a short diff snippet of the behavioral change here that helps speed review.

alex li: Sure — gist of the change:
```
- prefetch_if_needed(batch)
+ if batch.seq_len > PREFETCH_THRESHOLD && prefetch_would_evicted_prefix(batch):
+   fallback_to_single_request(batch)
+ else:
+   prefetch_if_needed(batch)
```
Added unit test that simulates seq_len=4096 and ensures no double-allocs.

lee tan: Left a couple of inline comments about locking around the attn kernel switch — looks like the kernel toggle isn't fully synchronized if two batches race. Could lead to using the wrong kernel for a short window. Also saw an unrelated macos-lint failure in CI (flake).

ci-bot: CI started for PR #1234 — unit / integration / perf-smoke. Current status: unit=pass, integration=running, perf-smoke=queued. (If integration fails, please rerun; known flake: kafka-test on ubuntu-20.04)

alex li: Thanks Lee — I'll add a small mutex around the kernel toggle and push a follow-up. Maria, if you still prefer moving decision into kv_cache I can sketch the plumbing in the same PR.

david cho: Skim done, left one comment about the test harness race. Otherwise looks safe to me.

alex li: Addressed Lee and David's comments and pushed a fix + force-rerun CI. If there are no other concerns, I'll merge at 00:30 UTC and monitor runtime metrics for 15m. If anyone wants to opt-out of the merge window ping me here. :thumbsup:

maria gonzalez: PTAL done, fine with merging after CI.

lee tan: LGTM after the mutex change — thanks for the quick follow-up.

david cho: +1

ci-bot: CI complete: unit=pass, integration=pass, perf-smoke=pass.

alex li: Merging now. Will post a quick note if the rollout triggers anything odd. Thanks all! :rocket:
